method: agent-assisted review of current platform documentation, large-sample industry research and transparent individual experiments
scope: Evidence-policy and hypothesis input only. No record in this file proves a ranking factor, causal traffic effect, universal AI-citation rule or absence of paid acquisition.

source_classes.official-platform: Best suited to provider requirements, eligibility, controls, reporting semantics and explicitly documented recommendations.
source_classes.large-sample-observational: Useful for prevalence, association, drift and cohort behaviour; does not establish causality.
source_classes.individual-experiment: Useful for a narrowly specified feature behaviour when setup and limitations are inspectable; not automatically generalizable.
source_classes.commentary: May generate hypotheses but cannot promote a recommendation without stronger evidence.

records.title: Optimizing your website for generative AI features on Google Search
records.finding: Foundational SEO remains relevant. Google states that llms.txt, special AI markup, artificial content chunking and AI-specific rewriting are not required for visibility in Google Search generative features.
records.caveat: Does not disclose ranking weights or guarantee inclusion.

records.title: Publishers and Developers - FAQ
records.claim_scope: ChatGPT search discovery and crawler controls
records.finding: OAI-SearchBot access is relevant to inclusion of page content in ChatGPT search summaries and snippets; training controls are separate.
records.use_in_goose: Keep search/retrieval eligibility separate from training preference.

records.title: Introducing AI Performance in Bing Webmaster Tools Public Preview
records.finding: Bing Webmaster Tools exposes citation activity and cited URLs across supported Microsoft AI experiences.
records.use_in_goose: Treat AI citations as a measurable owner-side outcome distinct from rankings, clicks and conversions.
records.caveat: A citation count does not establish correctness, user intent or causal value.

records.title: Perplexity Crawlers
records.finding: PerplexityBot is documented as a search/indexing crawler and not a foundation-model training crawler.
records.use_in_goose: Model Perplexity search eligibility independently from model-training policy.
records.caveat: Crawler access alone does not guarantee indexing or citation.

records.title: How Google's AI Mode Compares to Traditional Search and Other LLMs
records.claim_scope: Google AI Mode, AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity citation overlap
records.finding: The study reports strong domain-level association between classic Google top-10 visibility and AI citations, while URL-level overlap is lower and differs by surface.
records.use_in_goose: Measure classic Search and AI visibility together without assuming URL-level equivalence.
records.caveat: Correlation does not establish that organic ranking causes citation.

records.title: How Do Technical SEO Factors Impact AI Search?
records.method_summary: Five million cited URLs across ChatGPT Search and Google AI Mode, with subsets for structure, engagement and schema analysis.
records.finding: Technical and engagement characteristics show measurable associations with AI citations, with the authors explicitly limiting interpretation to correlation.
records.use_in_goose: Generate technical hypotheses only after eligibility blockers are handled.
records.caveat: Observed characteristics may be proxies for authority, content type or other confounders.

records.title: How We Built a Content Optimization Tool for AI Search
records.claim_scope: Text characteristics associated with AI citations
records.method_summary: 11,882 prompts, 59,410 Google keywords, 304,805 cited URLs and 921,614 Google-ranking URLs collected in July-August 2025.
records.finding: Clarity/summarization, E-E-A-T signals, Q&A format, section structure and structured elements were more prevalent in the cited sample under the study's scoring method.
records.use_in_goose: Candidate page-type experiments, never a universal formatting template.
records.caveat: Text scoring and sample construction can encode confounders; the study does not prove that adding a feature creates citations.

records.title: AI Citation drift: How stable are sources in AI search results?
records.claim_scope: AI source persistence across engines and countries
records.method_summary: 82,619 prompts tracked over 17 weeks across multiple platforms and six countries.
records.finding: The study reports high weekly source replacement, including 56% for Google and 74% for ChatGPT in its measured setup.
records.use_in_goose: Require repeated snapshots and citation-persistence metrics; shorten review windows for volatile claims.
records.caveat: Rates are specific to the tracked prompt set, product versions, countries and observation period.

records.title: The Most-Cited Domains in AI: A 3-Month Study
records.method_summary: More than 230,000 prompts observed weekly over 13 weeks and more than 100 million total citations.
records.finding: Large changes in citation share occurred for major sources over the observation window, reinforcing that AI source selection is time-sensitive.
records.use_in_goose: Treat a source/citation state as dated evidence rather than a permanent rank.
records.caveat: Domain-level citation share can hide substantial query- and URL-level differences.

records.title: AIO Impact on Google CTR: 2026 Update
records.claim_scope: Organic and paid CTR around Google AI Overviews
records.method_summary: Full-year 2025 analysis across 53 brands, 5.47 million tracked queries and 2.43 billion organic impressions, with Q1 2026 observations.
records.finding: AIO-present cohorts generally showed lower organic CTR, citation status mattered, and early-2026 CTR behaviour changed direction versus the prior decline trend.
records.use_in_goose: Track query-specific AIO/citation cohorts; reject fixed historical CTR penalties.
records.caveat: AIO-prone query cohorts differ systematically from non-AIO cohorts; the study itself discusses selection effects and tracking limitations.

records.title: Update: AI Overviews Reduce Clicks by 58%
records.claim_scope: CTR association for top-ranking informational pages when AI Overviews are present
records.finding: The updated analysis reports a larger CTR reduction association than Ahrefs' 2025 study, showing that the measured effect changed materially over time.
records.use_in_goose: Store CTR studies as dated observations and compare methodologies instead of encoding one permanent coefficient.
records.caveat: The estimate is method- and cohort-dependent and should not be treated as a universal causal penalty.

records.title: Why 62% of AI citations don't lead to brand mentions
records.claim_scope: Difference between source citation and explicit brand mention
records.method_summary: 3,981 domain appearances for 115 prompts across 14 countries and four AI search surfaces.
records.finding: Citation and explicit brand mention frequently diverged and varied by engine, country, query type and content type.
records.use_in_goose: Track citation presence, brand mention, context and referral separately.
records.caveat: The prompt panel is relatively small compared with broad web-scale studies and should be replicated for a target market.

records.title: AI Mode Tracking in Google Search Console Confirmed
records.claim_scope: Observed Search Console handling of AI Mode impressions
records.finding: A coordinated experiment used repeated searches to test how AI Mode visibility appeared in Search Console reporting.
records.use_in_goose: Useful feature-behaviour evidence when official reporting details are incomplete or changing.
records.caveat: Provider UI/reporting can change and the result must be rechecked before reuse.

records.title: What makes a good listicle?
records.claim_scope: Listicle prevalence and features associated with top-three Google rankings
records.method_summary: Follow-up analysis referencing 5.3 million search results and 60,000 queries.
records.finding: In the published analysis, freshness was the feature that predicted top-three ranking while several commonly cited format signals did not; query intent and vertical mattered strongly.
records.use_in_goose: Example of why page-format advice must be tested by query intent/vertical instead of promoted universally.
records.caveat: The exact modelling choices and paywalled details should be reviewed before deriving a specific implementation rule.

winner_observatory_policy.candidate_winner_requires: A dated, defined query/prompt cohort plus repeated evidence of new or materially improved organic/citation visibility. One screenshot is insufficient.
controls: stable incumbent in the same cohort
cited but weakly ranking page where observable
same URL before/after a meaningful revision where available

promotion_policy: Official provider guidance may directly update provider-specific eligibility/control rules after source review.
A single correlational study or individual experiment may create or reprioritize a hypothesis but does not become a universal recommendation.
Repeated compatible findings from independent methods increase prior confidence but still require site applicability review.
Target-site negative or neutral experiments remain visible and may lower local priority even when external evidence is positive.
Material provider contradiction, product change or high citation drift reopens dependent claims for review.
Stale unsupported advice becomes review-due or retired rather than silently persisting.

conflicts_and_resolutions.external_signal: Some observational studies associate certain textual structures with citations.
conflicts_and_resolutions.provider_signal: Google explicitly says special AI formatting, artificial chunking and AI-specific rewriting are not required.
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: Treat structural findings as page-type hypotheses for readability/citability, never as a Google requirement.

conflicts_and_resolutions.external_signal: Multiple studies report large CTR differences, with estimates and trends changing over time.
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: Store dated cohort observations and measure the target site's own exposed queries instead of applying a universal CTR loss coefficient.

conflicts_and_resolutions.external_signal: Large studies show both overlap with classic Search strength and substantial citation drift.
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: Use classic Search as a related foundation but track AI citations, persistence and brand mentions as independent longitudinal outcomes.
